analyzer_diagnosis.reasoning: The Kconfig warning indicates that NET_STATISTICS_VPN was enabled, but its dependency NET_VPN was not. This misconfiguration leads to the linker errors, as the functions related to VPN packet manipulation (e.g., net_pkt_set_vpn_iface) are not compiled into the application when NET_VPN is disabled. Graph retrieval is needed to understand the dependencies of NET_VPN and how to properly enable VPN support for WireGuard.
